currentParagraphText: “Thank you for the invitation. It was a lovely evening, and the food was absolutely wonderful, especially the soup,” Diana said, nodding her head.

finalResult.previousParagraphText: “We’ll certainly take you up on the offer once it’s possible for us to go there,” Solana answered with a bow.
